status: Accepted OMF damage handling. Agreed first-release OMF requirements baseline ready to move to native WAV/AIFF review; no runtime implementation/cutover.

authorization.statement: OK, let's lock those damage handling rules in for Bella. Is there anything else we need to decide for OMF before moving on to WAV and AIFF?
authorization.scope: Accepts the proposed general OMF damage boundaries, compact checks/statuses, independent physical/source facts and read-only scan policy. Does not approve new format support, source priority/opening/scheduling, unresolved shared labels or runtime/cutover.

agreedBellaRules.releaseScope: Already-agreed OMF1/Bento1 container/version/text/owner rules only; no OMF2, overlay, extended-label, Windows or raw-byte recovery support added.
agreedBellaRules.foundation: Validate complete supported TOC framing and required file-local mapping/membership/ownership before publishing that OMF contribution. One temporary TOC read/index followed by only needed metadata payloads; no whole media/essence read or permanent raw graph.
agreedBellaRules.valueFailure: Safely bounded bad text/numeric/payload/continuation invalidates that value and dependent answers; retain independent facts and only agreed separate fallbacks.
agreedBellaRules.linkFailure: Bad own ID, conflicting singular claim or unresolved required link invalidates dependent owner/association facts, not separately qualified branches. No arbitrary first/last or substitute unrelated owner.
agreedBellaRules.structuralFailure: Unsafe/incomplete shared framing or unusable required global ownership foundation rejects that OMF container contribution. Retain physical row and independent eligible database/filesystem/native-audio facts; expected format failures permit other files to continue. No unsafe structural-prefix salvage.
agreedBellaRules.completeness: Structural completeness differs from decoding every optional value. Relevant lookup must be complete to prove absence/default/NoReference; unrelated bounded optional failure does not prevent independent absence. Scope a bad mapping to demonstrably dependent facts when possible.
agreedBellaRules.unsupportedAndRepeated: Safely framed optional unknown data is skipped; needed unsupported forms unavailable. Preserve legitimate ordered arrays, declared continuations and identical repeats without treating all repetition as conflicting singular claims.
agreedBellaRules.fieldRules: Keep approved Unicode/separate legacy MacRoman, exact timing and damaged-vs-absent DF, Kind/Type/category, compression and summary rules. Short audio summaries omit samples intentionally; metadata readability is not media playback validation.
agreedBellaRules.sources: Native WAV/AIFF facts already independently read survive bad embedded OMF. No new fallback read, read trigger, priority or scheduling decision. General source capture/retry policy remains later; length stability is not proof against in-place change.
agreedBellaRules.implementation: Small C++17/Qt6.5.3 exact typed/bounds helpers, checked arithmetic/representability before indexing/allocation, scoped resources, compact availability/reasons and summary diagnostics. Release temporary bytes/indexes; no repair/recovery framework, permanent rejected-byte history or blanket corrupt catch.
agreedBellaRules.outcomes: Keep I/O, cancellation, detected source change, unsupported scope and resource/programming failures distinct from malformed metadata. Do not publish cancelled jobs as successful or hide out-of-memory/programming failures as corrupt files.
agreedBellaRules.noRepair: No automatic file/database delete, rewrite, rebuild, raw-byte resynchronization or guessed replacement records.
agreedBellaRules.currentBoundary: Current OMF metadata-only flow frames TOC before deferred payload reads; preserved partial source objects/no explicit framing gate is not proof of demonstrated decoded-prefix publication or crash. Broad Complete can inhibit independent absence/defaults.
agreedBellaRules.verificationBoundary: Static source/native checks and inspected synthetic cases; no malformed-input runtime campaign, damaged physical sample, native/private API/parser/test/build execution or measured Bella gain. No 100percent semantic/crash safety guarantee.

closureAssessment.basis: All focused OMF version/text, identity/ownership, retained-field, reading/lifetime and damage rules are agreed.
closureAssessment.next: Native WAV/AIFF reading and supported audio representations; then final cross-source priorities/opening/scheduling and brief design.
sharedFollowUps: Uncommon rate-label precision/representability remains bounded shared review.
Fixed 10.6/12.4 generic Bit Depth label remains shared follow-up; approved OMF rules already keep unestablished generic combinations unavailable.
Final source precedence including native audio/embedded OMF and reasons to read another source remain deferred.
verificationNotNewScope: Opposite numeric byte order, uncommon supported representations and malformed-input cases must be verified in implementation.
Required outputs, scan time and peak memory must be compared after implementation.
closureAssessment.unchangedScope: OMF1/Bento1 baseline; OMF2/extended/update forms deferred. No new decoder, header trigger, Bin Filter change or app switch.
